items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Well, Willie Best had that apartment, and we used to talk.

ctx.x: -- Duke Ellington. I was stopping at his home, and I knew his wife Rose Tizol. She was quite a comedian, you know, natural comedian. I don't mean like a professional comedian. She was funny, and she and Lena Horne were very good friends, and Lena often came over and this is how I ran into Lena. I hadn't seen her since the days of Charley Barnet. And she came over one day to see Rose Tizol, and incidentally, she had a two room apartment over the garage in the back that she was renting to a movie star. Guess who?…
